# czc-v2026.10.27.3 (0.2.18.5)

Image generation clients now receive a JSON error when an OAuth image upstream
returns a nonretryable error inside an HTTP 200 response. Previously the gateway
could finish with an empty response or only keepalive whitespace.

## Changes since czc-v2026.10.27.2

- Return the upstream error type, code, message and parameter when no actual
  response body has been sent to the client.
- Preserve the error HTTP status when it has not yet been committed. If a JSON
  keepalive has already committed HTTP 200, append the structured JSON error so
  clients can identify the failure from the response body.
- Keep retryable upstream errors eligible for account failover. Do not append
  another error to responses that already contain meaningful output.
- Cover nonretryable and retryable errors with keepalive disabled, pending and
  already committed, using the `gpt-image-2` image generation request shape.

This fixes a confirmed error-reporting defect. It does not establish or claim a
fix for the separately reported WorkBuddy ECONNRESET. Image-generation requests
still need the Images API endpoint rather than the Chat Completions endpoint.

## VERSION

`0.2.18.5`

## Upgrade guidance and compatibility

- No database migration, configuration update or API key replacement is needed.
- Clients should inspect the JSON `error` field even after HTTP 200, because
  keepalive can commit the status before upstream image generation finishes.
- Successful image output, model routing and retry policy are unchanged.
- Build from this exact tag, rebuild the frontend immediately before the
  `-tags embed` server build, and set `main.ReleaseURL` to this origin release.

## Verification

Passed on the fix or integrated `dev-czc` tree before release metadata:

- Image regression tests across `internal/service`, `internal/handler` and
  `internal/server/routes` with `-tags=unit -run 'Images|ImageGeneration'`.
- Complete service package: `go test -tags=unit ./internal/service -count=1
  -timeout=10m` (258.738 seconds, exit 0).
- Complete `internal/handler`, `internal/server/routes` and
  `internal/util/responseheaders` suites with `-tags=unit -timeout=120s`.
- Image error and JSON keepalive race checks with `-race -tags=unit`.
- Image and update-service focused regression checks.
- `go vet -tags=unit` for the four backend packages above.
- Frontend `vue-tsc -b`, locale-key completeness tests (3 passed), and Vite
  production build. The build reported dependency-age, dynamic-import and
  chunk-size warnings without failing.
- `git diff --check`.

Failed, interrupted or not performed:

- Before the fix, the new nonretryable-error cases reproduced the empty HTTP
  200 / whitespace-only response. They pass with the fix.
- The first broad backend run used `-timeout=180s`; the service package did
  not complete within that limit. The other three packages passed. The service
  suite subsequently passed with the 10-minute limit noted above.
- An intermediate JSON-output filtering command had a shell/Python quoting
  error and was not counted as validation; the successful rerun retained the
  normal Go test output instead.
- Repository-wide backend tests, Docker-backed integration tests, backend e2e,
  golangci-lint, frontend full Vitest/lint and browser e2e were not run for this
  narrowly scoped backend change.
- No paid live image request or WorkBuddy client reproduction was performed as
  part of the release checks.

The final `main-czc` commit must pass image/update regressions and static checks
before tagging. Installation is accepted only after the root page returns HTTP
200, the installed version is `0.2.18.5`, and the running update-check response
reports `https://github.com/zuchengchen/sub2api/releases/tag/czc-v2026.10.27.3`.

## Rollback

Restore the pre-install binary saved as
`/opt/sub2api/sub2api.bak.czc-v2026.10.27.3-<UTC timestamp>` and restart
`sub2api.service`, or rebuild and deploy `czc-v2026.10.27.2` (`0.2.18.4`).
No database or configuration rollback is required. Verify HTTP 200, version
`0.2.18.4` and the previous origin release URL after rollback.
